title: qq bot account status response: current bot identity, gateway state and group counts

appId.description: AppID of the configured bot. It is a public identifier, not a credential.

credentialsConfigured.description: True when both AppID and AppSecret are set; without them nothing is sent and no bot lookup is attempted.

bot.description: Identity of the bot itself, read from GET /users/@me and cached for 10 minutes.

name.description: Bot display name (username from the platform); empty when unavailable.

avatarUrl.description: Absolute avatar URL as returned by the platform; empty when unavailable or when the platform returned something that is not an absolute URL.

available.description: False when the identity could not be read (no credentials, invalid credentials, network failure); the route still answers 200.

reason.description: Readable Chinese reason when available is false; null when the identity was read successfully.

gateway.description: State of the long-lived event connection, read from the plugin's own process state; answering this never performs a request.

state.description: Same five states the delivery status text reports.

reason.description: Last readable error of the connection, empty when there is none.

since.description: RFC 3339 timestamp the current connection started, derived from its uptime; null when not connected.

groups.description: How many groups the plugin knows about.

recognized.description: Groups seen in the bot's own group events, the same source the group list uses.

whitelisted.description: Distinct non-empty entries in the group whitelist setting, the same count the settings page shows.
